crud_roundtrip.statement: add stores a task with id, title, description, priority, status and due_date; update changes only given fields; delete removes it; unknown id exits 1.

enum_validation.statement: Priority outside low/medium/high, status outside todo/in-progress/done, empty title or malformed due_date exits 1 and stores nothing.

sqlite_persistence.statement: Tasks written by one process invocation are read by the next from the SQLite file, using raw sqlite3 with parameterized queries.
must_include: persist in SQLite with raw sqlite3

filter_status_priority.statement: list --status and --priority return only matching tasks, and both together apply AND.

mark_done.statement: done <id> sets status to done and leaves other fields unchanged; unknown id exits 1.

table_output.statement: list prints a header row (ID, TITLE, PRIORITY, STATUS, DUE) and aligned columns, one row per task.

single_file_stdlib.statement: task_manager.py imports only stdlib modules and runs standalone as the CLI entry point.
